Which statement about ammonia is correct?
A
It conducts electricity when liquid.
B
It contains three covalent bonds.
C
It has a high boiling point.
D
It has a giant covalent structure.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a high boiling point.

options.label: D
options.text: It has a giant covalent structure.
